pages.text: Day 1. Science starts with looking. I use a $(item)Spectral Analyzer$() on unusual blocks (beacons, end portal frames, amethyst, sculk, Cherenkov ore...), on Endermen and Wardens, and on $(thing)running$() Theoretical Sciences machines.

Every $(thing)new$() observation grants $(thing)Insight$(). Sneak-use the analyzer to observe the sky of the dimension you are in - splitting starlight into a spectrum is how astronomers first learned what stars are made of.$(br2)Multiblocks are worth the most. A running machine, it turns out, is the best teacher.
Right-click phenomena, blocks or creatures to gain Insight.$(br2)Made in a crafting grid.
